summary: Resources Connection, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the retirement of two directors, A. Robert Pisano and Robert Kistinger, effective immediately prior to the 2026 annual meeting, with no disagreement with the company. The CEO was appointed Chair and a Lead Independent Director named, reducing board size to six. The filing also notes a 50% reduction in the non-employee Chair retainer. These are routine board transitions and compensation policy changes, not a special situation event such as a forced departure or activist campaign.
